      public UserId findUserById(int id, boolean with_posts, int page)
      Finds a user by its id. Adding with_posts (true or false), it will retrieve all posts by the user. Use paginator to retrieve all
      Parameters:
      id - The id of the user
      with_posts - True or False (if included, posts will be given)
